questions.stem: An 11-year-old Chandu is referred to neurology by his doctor for frequent sniffing despite a lack of congestion or seasonal allergies. For the last year, he frequently sniffed for no reason and began to flick his finger throughout the day. On examination, you appreciate the noted mannerisms, and also note frequent throat clearing, echolalia and palilalia. The patient reports that he feels anxious unless he performs the action and has a sense of relief after performing the action. They are also suppressible. Which of the following is a comorbidity of this condition?
